title: PAK vs SL Live streaming details, where & how to watch Final ODI of Pakistan Tri-Series 2026

 PAK vs SL Live streaming details, where & how to watch Final ODI of Pakistan Tri-Series 2026
 By Karan Rawat Follow Add as Preferred Source Karan is a passionate cricket writer with a sharp eye for the game’s nuances. Published at : October 31, 2026 at 12:55 PM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : October 31, 2026 at 12:55 PM (GMT+5:30) PAK vs SL Final game will be played at Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore on Saturday.
 Pakistan and Sri Lanka have qualified for the final of the ongoing ODI tri-Series. After losing three of four, England have been eliminated. The final will be played at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore on Saturday at 1:30 PM IST.
 Pakistan started the tri-series with three good wins, but they failed to replicate the success in the fourth game against Sri Lanka. The whole team was bowled out for 110 runs. They made some changes to their batting lineup in the last game.
 The form of Fakhar Zaman and Babar Azam has been an issue. They would want to regain their form in the final. On the other hand, Sri Lanka showed good batting form, but in two games, they have conceded more than 380 runs.
 That has become the problem with them. Though they bowled well against Pakistan, but need more consistency. Both teams have some flaws, but this is the final, and they will be ready to put their best foot forward.

 PAK vs SL Final ODI of Tri-Series 2026: Match Details
 Match: Pakistan (PAK) vs Sri Lanka (SL), Final ODI, Pakistan Tri-Series 2026
 Match Date: October 31, 2026 (Saturday)
 Time: 1:30 PM IST / 8:00 AM GMT / 1:00 PM local time
 Toss Time: 1:00 PM IST / 7:30 AM GMT / 12:30 PM local time
 Venue: Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore
 When to watch the PAK vs SL Final ODI of the Tri-Series 2026? Timing details
 The final of the tri-series will begin at 1:30 PM IST / 2 PM local time on Saturday at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore. The toss is scheduled to take place at 1:00 PM IST / 1:30 PM local time.
 How to watch the PAK vs SL Final ODI of the Tri-Series 2026 in India?
 Indian fans can catch the live telecast of the final on the Veto streaming platform in India.
 How to watch the PAK vs SL Final ODI of the Tri-Series 2026 in Pakistan?
 Pakistani fans can watch the live telecast on PTV Sports on TV. The live stream of the game will be accessible on Tapmad or Tamasha apps, and PCB Live.
 Where to watch the PAK vs SL Final ODI of Tri-Series 2026? Country-wise TV and live streaming details

 When and where the PAK vs SL final take place?
 The final will be played on Saturday, October 31, at Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore.
 How to watch the PAK vs SL final of the tri-series in India?
 Fans in India can watch the PAK vs SL final on the Veto streaming platform.
